title: Scaffold field parsing
responsibility: Converts field specifications into normalized code names, database columns and supported language types.

inputs.name: parseFields.rawFields
inputs.description: Each string is a field name, optionally followed by a colon and a type; a string without a colon defaults to string, and an empty type after a colon is rejected. The type is trimmed before it is checked against string, text, number, boolean, date and json, and any string with more than one colon is rejected.

outputs.name: parseFields
outputs.description: Each input string yields one Field, in input order, with a camelCase name, a snake_case column and the trimmed type; names are unique because duplicate camelCase names throw. tsType is string for string, text and date, number for number, boolean for boolean and Record<string, unknown> for json; sqlType is TEXT for string, text, date and json and INTEGER for number and boolean.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail() when a field string has more than one colon, when validateFieldName rejects the name, when its trimmed type is not string, text, number, boolean, date or json, or when two fields share a camelCase name. Every field is parsed before duplicates are checked, and no fields are returned when it is thrown.
